parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: The line from which the query starts. The default value is 0.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page for a paged query. The maximum value is 500. The default value is 500.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sls list-dashboard --project ali-test-project --offset 0 --size 10 --tags value=value1 key=key1 --dashboard-name dashboard-1609294922657-434834 --display-name test --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sls GET /dashboards --project ali-test-project --region cn-hangzhou --offset 0 --size 10 --displayName test --tags '[{"value":"value1","key":"key1"}]' --dashboardName 'dashboard-1609294922657-434834' --header "Content-Type=application/json"
